name: United Parcel Service
description: UPS delivers packages and runs logistics for businesses. About 67% of revenue is US domestic small package (ground, air and deferred), 21% is international package (mostly express export), and 12% is Supply Chain Solutions (freight forwarding, contract logistics, healthcare cold-chain, Roadie, Happy Returns). It earns money per package (17.5M US packages a day at $13.21 average revenue per piece in 2025) plus fuel surcharges, so profit depends on package volume filling a very large fixed network of hubs, aircraft and unionized drivers. Its largest customer, Amazon (10.6% of 2025 revenue), is being deliberately cut: UPS reduced Amazon volume by more than 50% from 2024 levels by Q2 2026 to favor higher-yield small-business and healthcare volume, closing buildings and cutting jobs. That reset drove a $1.17B restructuring charge in Q2 2026 and cut Q2 operating profit by 49%.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge; not re-checked against MSCI/S&P. SEC SIC 4210 (Trucking & Courier Services, No Air) is a legacy code.

hq.note: 55 Glenlake Parkway N.E., Atlanta, GA 30328 (FY2025 10-K cover)

employees.note: About 460,000 excluding temporary seasonal: 370,000 US, 90,000 international; about 295,000 US employees under the Teamsters national master agreement running to July 31, 2028 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: U.S. Domestic Package
businessLines.how: Per-package revenue plus fuel surcharge on a fixed hub, aircraft and driver network; margin depends on volume density and mix. Ground $44,183M, Next Day Air $9,652M, Deferred $4,446M, Cargo and other $1,238M in 2025.
businessLines.description: Next Day Air, Deferred air and Ground package delivery in the US, including Ground Saver (residential lightweight, with USPS handling a portion of final-mile delivery from 2026).

businessLines.name: International Package
businessLines.how: Premium express export revenue per piece ($32.61) on a global air and ground network; margin higher than domestic.
businessLines.description: Export, domestic (within-country) and import package delivery in Europe, Asia-Pacific, Canada, Latin America and other regions.

businessLines.name: Supply Chain Solutions (SCS)
businessLines.how: Fees for freight forwarding, warehousing and value-added logistics; margins are lower and project-like. Healthcare logistics is the growth focus.
businessLines.description: Forwarding $2,916M (2024 $4,728M after the Coyote sale), logistics $5,855M (contract logistics, healthcare cold-chain such as Andlauer and Frigo-Trans), other SCS $1,795M (Roadie, Happy Returns, UPS Store).

whatsNext.text: USPS to support final-mile delivery for a portion of Ground Saver volume beginning in 2026 (agreement December 2025)
